examples.en: Then Mischel discovered something really interesting.
examples.zh: 后来米歇尔发现了一些非常有趣的事。

examples.en: In 1972, Professor Walter Mischel tested the willpower of 600 four-year-olds to six-year-olds.
examples.zh: 1972年，沃尔特·米歇尔教授测试了600名4岁至6岁儿童的意志力。

examples.en: What the children are doing, says Mischel, is distracting themselves.
examples.zh: Mischel教授说，小朋友们其实是在分散自己的注意力。
